author: tom.verbeke@foo.be
title: Office Wi-Fi & printers
body:
Wi-Fi: connect to "Foo-Staff" with your company login. Guests use "Foo-Guest", the password is on the screen at reception.
Printers: there is one printer per floor. Scan-to-email works from all printers. If a printer is jammed, don't open the back panel, contact IT.
